sloka: शेषं च मयि विश्रान्तः सुखेनातिपतिष्यति ।इति कृत्वा मतिं साध्वीं समुद्रश्चन्नमम्भसि ॥५-१-९१॥
transliteration: śeṣaṁ ca mayi viśrāntaḥ sukhenātipatiṣyati ।iti kṛtvā matiṁ sādhvīṁ samudraścannamambhasi ॥5-1-91॥

translations.english: Having resolved in his mind, the Seagod addressed the noble, golden mount Mainaka, hidden in the sea:
